aliases.name: L85A2
aliases.note: The current standard rifle configuration; figures in this entry describe it.

massEmpty.sourceNote: L85A2 with SUSAT sight and a loaded 30-round magazine; the infobox cites a UK MoD PDF that no longer resolves and has no working archive link found, so the figure is recorded as estimated rather than verified

length.sourceNote: L85A2, from the infobox, uncited on Wikipedia

barrelLength.sourceNote: L85A2, from the infobox, uncited on Wikipedia

cyclicRate.sourceNote: midpoint of the published, uncited range of 610-775 rounds a minute

effectiveRange.sourceNote: the infobox cites the British Army's own equipment page, which returned a 403 error rather than resolving, so this figure is recorded as estimated rather than verified

productionTotal.sourceNote: L85 and L86 combined, published as 'approx. 350,000', uncited on Wikipedia; the L98 cadet rifle's separate figure of approx. 21,700 is not included

capacity.sourceNote: 30-round detachable STANAG magazine, from the infobox, uncited on Wikipedia; a 60-round casket magazine and a 20-round carbine magazine are also published for other configurations
